run_lammps_with_fairchem_predictor: run a LAMMPS simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor with a given input script and task name
create_fix_external_callback: create a FixExternalCallback to compute MLIP forces, energy, and virial during LAMMPS timesteps
convert_lammps_data_to_atomic_data: convert LAMMPS atom positions, types, and box data into a FairChem AtomicData tensor object
lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers from atomic mass values using closest match against ASE reference masses
convert_lammps_box_to_cell_matrix: convert a LAMMPS triclinic box definition into an ASE-compatible 3x3 unit cell matrix
